analysisType.description: The type of analysis that was performed.

files.description: The list of files associated with the analysis.

items.description: Contains information about the files generated from a run of sequencing or data analysis

fileMd5sum.description: Computed md5sum of the file. If not provided, will be populated by molecular submission workflow.

fileName.description: File name, subdirectory-relative path, or absolute path of the data file. For more details see https://github.com/Pan-Canadian-Genome-Library/molecular-data-submission-workflow/blob/main/docs/input.md.

fileSize.description: Size of the file, in bytes. If not provided, will be populated by molecular submission workflow.

submitter_analysis_id.description: Unique identifier of the analysis within the study, assigned by the data provider.

submitter_experiment_ids.description: A list of Unique identifiers (min 1) for experiments within the study, assigned by the data provider.

workflow.description: Contains information about the analysis workflow generating the analysis

submitter_workflow_id.description: Indicate the unique identifier of the data processing workflow used in the analysis.

workflow_name.description: The name of the genomic data processing workflow used for data analysis.

workflow_url.description: A URL linking to the workflow's repository or documentation. This could be a reference to a GitHub repository, a website where the workflow is described, or documentation on how to run the workflow.

workflow_version.description: The version of the workflow or pipeline being used.
